categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: financial automation service machines (including ATM and related hardware/software), system integration services (covering software/hardware planning, development, and large public engineering projects), and maintenance services (providing 24/7 technical support and upkeep). It also has business operations in mainland China focusing on intelligent inspection and management systems, and overseas sales and market development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as biometric authentication (finger vein recognition), cloud-based SaaS platforms, GPS and GIS for intelligent operation systems, and integrates hardware/software solutions for financial automation and system integration. It holds multiple patents and certifications including ISO 9001, CMMI Level 3, and ISO 27001, emphasizing quality management and information security. Production involves importing and integrating hardware components, software development, and system assembly tailored to customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include banks and financial institutions, government agencies (e.g., police, fire departments, transportation authorities), telecom operators, and large enterprises. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with a strong presence in Taiwan's financial automation sector, and expanding markets in mainland China and Southeast Asia. Major projects include public communication systems, transportation dispatch systems, and financial automation equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Taiwan, with extensive service and maintenance networks covering the entire island including offshore islands. It has a subsidiary in Nanjing, China, focusing on software development and intelligent management systems. Overseas sales target mainland China and emerging Asian markets such as Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It acts as an exclusive agent for Hitachi financial automation products in Taiwan, integrates hardware and software solutions, and provides system integration and maintenance services. It does not manufacture core hardware components but assembles and customizes systems for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening relationships with major customers through integrated total solutions and CRM systems, enhancing product quality and delivery accuracy, and strengthening risk and cost control. R&D focuses on developing next-generation financial automation equipment (e.g., smart teller machines, cash recycling machines), cloud-based SaaS platforms like 'Field Service Cloud', biometric authentication technologies, and expanding digital media and mobile payment solutions. The company also emphasizes information security and occupational health management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of financial automation machines and system integration projects, supplemented by recurring maintenance and technical support services. The company also earns income from software licensing, SaaS subscriptions, and digital advertising services deployed in commercial venues. Large public engineering projects contribute significant contract revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in Taiwan’s financial automation sector, with over 50% market share in ATMs, being the exclusive agent for Hitachi products. Competitors include NCR, Diebold Nixdorf, and domestic firms like OKI. In system integration, the company competes in specialized government and enterprise projects with few capable rivals due to the complexity and domain expertise required.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$4.87 billion, a 22.7% increase year-over-year, with net profit growing by 12.6%. The company maintains a stable asset base of about NT$7.7 billion and equity of NT$3.1 billion. It has demonstrated steady growth driven by large project completions and expanding maintenance income. R&D expenses remain significant, supporting innovation and product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, integrated financial automation and system solutions tailored to customer needs, supported by extensive after-sales maintenance and 24/7 service. Its exclusive partnership with Hitachi and strong R&D capabilities enable it to offer advanced, differentiated products such as biometric authentication ATMs and cloud-based management platforms. The broad service network and deep domain expertise in public sector projects further differentiate it from competitors.
